text: attempt 1 begins

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Target radar facilities and AA weaponry.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: They're set up on rugged terrain and there's a lot of cloud cover.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text:
You will be near thunderclouds.
Man, you guys were born unlucky.

speaker: Spare 8 Champ
text: Wait. Who's the dumbass who came up with this batshit plan?

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Just obey orders.

speaker: Cyclops 1 Wiseman
text: Air Force Base 444 Squadron, this is Cyclops 1.

speaker: Cyclops 1 Wiseman
text: The Cyclops and Strider squadrons currently contain seven aircraft.

speaker: Cyclops 1 Wiseman
text: Stand by. We'll be arriving shortly.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Understood.

speaker: Cyclops 1 Wiseman
text: We're low on ammunition. It'll be hard to take on hostiles.

speaker: Cyclops 1 Wiseman
text: We'll have to rely on you guys to make it home.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text:
Cyclops 1, this is Bandog.
We need the job done on time.

speaker: Cyclops 1 Wiseman
text:
Bandog? Cool name.
Nice working with you, Mr. Guard Dog.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: The terrain makes the airstream bumpy. Don't damage those planes.
manoeuvre: lift -90, pull 0.6, brake

speaker: Spare 6 Full band
text: Are you telling us we have to dodge lighting?

speaker: Spare 6 Full band
text: Missile incoming! Evade!

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Locked!

speaker: Spare 8 Champ
text: Trigger just wrecked one!

speaker: Spare 11 Tabloid
text:
Anti-surface attacks in this weather?
Gimme a break, man.

speaker: Spare 2 Count
text: Man, I need missions that can help me improve my score. Not this crap.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Chaff and flares are depleted.

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: The radar's working! We're under attack!

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: Don't wait for interceptors! Use missiles!

speaker: Spare 11 Tabloid
text: Looks an awful lot like Erusea's getting prepared for an all-out war to me.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Cut the crap. There's work to do.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Move on to the next target.

speaker: Spare 11 Tabloid
text: Fly between those rocks in this wind?!

speaker: Spare 8 Champ
text: Missile coming for you! Move it!

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: They're flying between the columns!

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Locked on target.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Destruction of target facility is confirmed.

speaker: Spare 2 Count
text: The regular forces' secret reconnaissance plane is deep inside Erusea?

speaker: Spare 6 Full band
text:
They're investigating the ruins.
That's all I know.

speaker: Spare 11 Tabloid
text:
You sure found out quick.
They got a secret weapon, maybe?

speaker: Spare 6 Full band
text: There's only so much I could find out.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Enough talk.

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: Do they have a death wish?!

speaker: Spare Squadron
text: I'd rather be back in my cell.

speaker: Spare 8 Champ
text:
There's no way I'm going back to the brig.
Don't get in my way.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Spare 15, Fox 2.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Destruction of target facility confirmed.

speaker: Spare Squadron
text: This mission is crazy. All our commander thinks about is looking good for the General Staff Office.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: The mission doesn't require you to talk.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Use your head as well as your hands.

speaker: Spare 2 Count
text: Righto.

speaker: Spare Squadron
text:
I can't see in this soup!
Gotta fly by instruments.

speaker: Spare 6 Full band
text: The enemy's gunning for me!

speaker: Spare 11 Tabloid
text: Careful. Don't crash into the mountains.

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: And unless you have a death wish, watch your altitude.

speaker: Erusean Ground Unit
text: Don't panic! They'll crash on their own!

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Five minutes remaining.

speaker: Spare 6 Full band
text: Ice on my wings!

speaker: Spare Squadron
text: This wind!

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Spare 15! Missile!
manoeuvre: lift -30, pull 0.6, none

speaker: Spare Squadron
text: The wind! I can't fly straight!

speaker: Spare 2 Count
text: Use the winds to guide you, amateurs!
manoeuvre: lift 30, pull 1.0, none
manoeuvre: holding -30|1.0|none

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: Spare 15, Fox 3.

why: no longer: beyond standard missile range

speaker: AWACS Bandog
text: SAM sites down. Keep destroying radar facilities.
manoeuvre: lift -30, pull 1.0, none

speaker: Spare 6 Full band
text: Trigger really screwed the pooch!
